answer: Price each identity to a scarce quartz-hard hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof each epoch, and weight its standing only as a vertex in a trust graph whose inbound edges come from already-established peers in separate funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet traces every edge back up one river to a single source, so its vertex folds onto itself and never gathers distinct cross-cluster signatures; an honest root pays one anchor once, a farm pays a fresh anchor plus a slow climb per head (linear).
